requirements_summary: Model/version pinning: immutable manifest (model hash, tokenizer version, quant config) exposed via API
Reproducibility: deterministic output for a golden suite of prompts given manifest + fixed RNG seed
Rollouts: percentage-based canaries with sticky routing for signed sessions; ability to tie rollout to eval-gate pass/fail
Eval gates: automated evaluation against golden prompts + static metrics (exact match, BLEU-style, edit distance) and sampling-based human review trigger
Streaming SLOs: first-byte <50ms typical, tail latency 95th <150ms for single-token streaming in NA region
Observability: token-level cost, per-manifest latency/correctness breakdown, and perf diffs between manifests
Failure modes: automatic rollback on regression thresholds + manual abort with annotated rollback reason
